seo.title: Indira Gandhi College of Nursing, Kochi | B.Sc. Nursing in Kadavanthra
seo.description: A four-year B.Sc. Nursing course at Indira Gandhi College of Nursing, Kadavanthra, Kochi, with clinical training at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital. Affiliated with KUHS; approved by INC and KNC.

image.alt: Healthcare trainees in blue scrubs practising with a stethoscope

hero.lead: A four-year B.Sc. Nursing course, taught inside a multispeciality hospital.

paragraphs: Indira Gandhi College of Nursing, established in 2006 at Kadavanthra, Kochi, offers a four-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing programme. Students receive academic instruction at the college and clinical training at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), gaining experience in different areas of patient care.
The college is affiliated with Kerala University of Health Sciences and approved by the Indian Nursing Council and the Kerala Nursing Council.

sections.heading: Why choose Indira Gandhi College of Nursing?

cards.title: Clinical training at a multi-speciality hospital
paragraphs: Students gain clinical experience at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, with exposure to different medical and surgical departments. Their training includes patient care in general wards, OPD, ICU, CCU, operation theatres and emergency services.

cards.title: Learning across specialised departments
paragraphs: The hospital's specialist departments provide students with exposure to different areas of nursing practice, including heart care, cancer care and dialysis and kidney care.

cards.title: A co-operative healthcare environment
paragraphs: IGCH is managed by Cochin Co-operative Hospitals Society Ltd. The hospital follows a co-operative approach to healthcare, with a focus on accessible treatment and patient support. Students learn in an environment where patient care and community health are important parts of hospital practice.

cards.title: Faculty, hostel and campus facilities
paragraphs: Students are guided by experienced nursing faculty and have access to classrooms, a library, computer facilities, hostel accommodation and a dining facility. The hostel is supervised by a warden, and transport is provided for community health postings.

facts.label: Approvals
facts.value: Indian Nursing Council and Kerala Nursing Council

sections.heading: Clinical Training at IGCH
paragraphs: Clinical training at a multispeciality hospital gives nursing students opportunities to learn about different conditions, treatments and patient care requirements.
Some of the key areas of exposure include:

cards.title: Heart Care
paragraphs: Students gain exposure to cardiology and cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, including patient care before and after cardiac procedures.

cards.title: Cancer Care
paragraphs: Training includes exposure to medical and surgical oncology, chemotherapy-related care and the nursing support required by cancer patients and their families.

cards.title: Dialysis and Kidney Care
paragraphs: Students learn about related conditions and the nursing care involved in dialysis and the management of patients with kidney disease.

after: Other clinical postings include emergency care, ICU, operation theatre, obstetrics, paediatrics and general medicine.

sections.heading: Campus Facilities
paragraphs: The college provides facilities to support academic learning and student life, including:
items: Library with nursing textbooks and journals

sections.heading: Admission to B.Sc. Nursing
paragraphs: Admission to the B.Sc. Nursing programme is through LBS allotment, subject to the applicable eligibility criteria and admission guidelines.
Students can refer to the latest admission notifications and college prospectus for information about eligibility, application procedures, fees and available seats.
after: For admission enquiries, contact the college office.

sections.heading: Location and Contact
paragraphs: Indira Gandhi College of Nursing is located on the campus of Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra, Kochi, Ernakulam, Keralam – 682020.
The hospital is opposite Rajiv Gandhi Indoor Stadium.
